import z3

# Define the graph
vertices = list(range(27))
edges = [(0,3), (0,9), (0,12), (0,21), (1,6), (1,11), (1,14), (1,16), (1,17), (1,20), (2,16), (2,17), (3,14), (3,22), (4,5), (4,8), (5,6), (5,11), (5,14), (5,20), (6,18), (6,24), (7,8), (7,11), (7,16), (7,22), (8,12), (8,14), (9,10), (9,11), (9,18), (9,25), (9,26), (10,13), (10,15), (11,14), (11,20), (13,15), (13,19), (13,25), (14,25), (15,22), (15,26), (16,20), (16,25), (17,25), (17,26), (18,23), (19,20), (21,22), (24,26)]

# Create solver
s = z3.Solver()

# Create color variables for each vertex
colors = [z3.Int(f'c_{v}') for v in vertices]

# Each color between 0 and 2
for v in vertices:
    s.add(colors[v] >= 0, colors[v] <= 2)

# Constraints for edges
for u, v in edges:
    s.add(colors[u] != colors[v])

# Check satisfiability
result = s.check()
print(result)

if result == z3.sat:
    model = s.model()
    coloring = [model[colors[v]].as_long() for v in vertices]
    print(coloring)
else:
    print("UNSATISFIABLE")
